cases.name: every column is not narrowed
cases.expect_survivor: Output-equivalent by construction: the cursor conceals every hidden column, so decoding them and nulling them returns the same rows. Narrowing is a decode-cost optimisation, measured at 25.9 ms median (24.0-29.6, 15 runs) against 40.6 ms (40.2-43.3) for 5,000 rows with a 10 KB hidden column. A test of it would be a timing assertion.
